description: Per-case overrides for the lwIP tap-interface DUT fixture (dut/lwip_dut/, driven via --topology external). Same two axes as the default Linux file: `expected:false` marks cases this fixture cannot execute meaningfully today (no SOME/IP responder / Upper Tester opcode not yet ported / vacuous-pass shapes), `platform_known_fail:true` marks verified lwIP stack behaviours that fail the TC8 assertion — RFC MUST/SHOULD deviations a strict-RFC DUT passes, plus TC8-beyond-RFC expectations (e.g. gratuitous-announcement learning, where lwIP follows RFC 826 literally and the Linux reference needs arp_accept=1 conditioning). Evidence and per-bucket discussion: dut/lwip_dut/README.md. Select with: tc8-harness test --inventory-overrides dut/lwip_dut/inventory_overrides.json.

ARP_05.reason: lwIP etharp implements the literal RFC 826 reception algorithm: a gratuitous Response not addressed to the DUT updates an EXISTING table entry but never creates one, so the cold cache stays cold and the DUT emits its own ARP Request (fail:dut_arp_request_after_gratuitous_learning). The Linux reference passes only via the arp_accept=1 per-case conditioning; lwIP has no equivalent knob (dut/lwip_dut/README.md)

The Linux reference passes only via the arp_accept=1 per-case conditioning; lwIP has no equivalent knob (dut/lwip_dut/README.md)

ARP_33.reason: both injections are gratuitous Responses not addressed to the DUT; lwIP etharp creates no table entry from either (RFC 826 literal: add only when the DUT is the target), the cache stays cold and the DUT emits its own ARP Request (fail:dut_arp_request_after_double_injection). Distinct mechanism from the Linux reference known-fail on the same case (arp_is_garp target_hw shape + LOCKTIME); ARP_34 passes here because its first injection is a Request addressed to the DUT (dut/lwip_dut/README.md)

ICMPv4_TYPE_11.reason: ICMP Timestamp not implemented (icmp.c counts ICMP_TS in stats and drops)

ICMPv4_TYPE_12.reason: ICMP Timestamp not implemented (icmp.c counts ICMP_TS in stats and drops)

ICMPv4_ERROR_02.reason: ICMP Parameter Problem emission not implemented (only dest-unreach/time-exceeded generators exist)

IPv4_FRAGMENTS_04.reason: reassembly bucket match omits the protocol field (IP_ADDRESSES_AND_ID_MATCH compares src/dst/id only; RFC 791 requires the src/dst/protocol/id quad)

IPv4_REASSEMBLY_11.reason: static IP_REASS_MAXAGE timer ignores TTL; RFC 791 MAX(TLB,TTL) extension not implemented (same deviation class as the Linux reference DUT)

IPv4_REASSEMBLY_13.reason: overlap reassembly structurally unsupported: chain validation requires exact fragment contiguity, so an overlapped bucket never completes regardless of IP_REASS_CHECK_OVERLAP

TCP_BASICS_17.reason: simultaneous open not implemented: a SYN arriving in SYN-SENT gets no SYN+ACK (RFC 793 p32 simultaneous-open figure); the stack later RSTs the tester's follow-up ACK

TCP_FLAGS_INVALID_06.reason: SYN-SENT answers an acceptable bare ACK with RST where RFC 793 p66 says discard-and-stay (Linux silently drops)

TCP_FLAGS_INVALID_07.reason: OTW-SEQ SYN in SYN-RCVD is dropped without the RFC 793 section 3.9 challenge ACK

TCP_URGENT_PTR_04.reason: TCP urgent/out-of-band data path not implemented (RFC 793 section 3.7 URG); the UT answers OpReceiveTcpDataOob with zero bytes by design

TCP_RETRANSMISSION_TO_05.reason: case observation window is shaped for the conditioned Linux fixture's linear SYN RTO (tcp_syn_linear_timeouts); lwIP's RFC 6298 exponential backoff exits the window — test-design concern, mirrors the TCP_UNACCEPTABLE_08 precedent

TCP_RETRANSMISSION_TO_06.reason: case observation window is shaped for the conditioned Linux fixture's linear SYN RTO (tcp_syn_linear_timeouts); lwIP's RFC 6298 exponential backoff exits the window — test-design concern, mirrors the TCP_UNACCEPTABLE_08 precedent

TCP_RETRANSMISSION_TO_08.reason: spec expects the data-retransmission RTO to plateau at 2*MSL (60 s); lwIP doubles RTO per retransmit with no 2*MSL clamp (tcp.c tcp_backoff shift, cap at <<7) and aborts at TCP_MAXRTX=12 — within the 35 s observation budget the RTO never repeats, deterministic fail:rto_below_2_msl_did_not_plateau_within_observation_budget (verified x2 2026-06-11)

TCP_RETRANSMISSION_TO_09.reason: spec expects the SYN-retransmission RTO to plateau at 2*MSL (60 s); lwIP never backs off the SYN RTO (tcp.c excludes SYN_SENT from RTO doubling, fixed 1 s cadence) and aborts the pcb at TCP_SYNMAXRTX=6 (~7 s) — the freed pcb makes OpQueryTcpInfo answer kStatusUnknownSocket, deterministic fail:tcp_info_query_failed (verified x2 2026-06-11)
